Meta.title: Pairly
Meta.description: AI does the work. You make the call. Together.

Common.tagline: AI does the work. You make the call. Together.

Org.label: Organisation
Org.noneHint: You are not in any organisation yet.

Command.title: Command menu
Command.description: Search for a page or an action.
Command.placeholder: Type a page or an action
Command.hint: Press {keys} any time to open this menu.

Auth.signInSubtitle: We email you a link. No password needed.
Auth.footnote: By signing in you agree to keep candidate and vendor data private.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.EXPIRED_TOKEN: That link has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.new_user_signup_disabled: This email has no Pairly account. Ask your admin for an invite.
errors.originMismatch: This address ({origin}) is not trusted by the auth server. Open Pairly at the address in BETTER_AUTH_URL, or add this origin to PAIRLY_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS. You only see this message in development.

CheckEmail.title: Check your email
CheckEmail.body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}.
CheckEmail.bodyNoEmail: We sent you a sign-in link.
CheckEmail.expires: The link works once and expires in 5 minutes.
CheckEmail.devHint: Running locally? Open Mailpit at localhost:8025.

Confirm.title: Finish signing in
Confirm.body: Select the button to sign in on this device.
Confirm.missing: This link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
Confirm.why: We ask for this click so that email scanners cannot use your link.

TwoFactor.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6 digit code for Pairly.
TwoFactor.invalid: That code did not work. Check the time on your phone and try again.
TwoFactor.expired: This sign-in has expired. Start again.
TwoFactor.setupBody: Add a code from an authenticator app each time you sign in. Admins and approvers will need this.
TwoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
TwoFactor.manual: Or enter this key by hand:
TwoFactor.backupBody: Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe. You will not see them again.
TwoFactor.freshSession: For your safety, sign in again before changing this.

Home.emptyBody: New approvals, flags and drafts will show up here first.

NotProvisioned.title: Your account is not set up yet
NotProvisioned.body: You are signed in as {email}. You can see work in Pairly once you join an organisation, and you join one by accepting an invitation from its admin.
NotProvisioned.step1: Ask your Pairly admin to send an invitation to this email address.
NotProvisioned.step2: Open the link in the invitation email and accept it. You will land here, ready to work.

Unavailable.title: We cannot reach Pairly right now
Unavailable.body: Your work is safe. Try again in a moment.

Placeholder.title: {section} is on its way
Placeholder.body: This area arrives in a later release. Home shows anything that needs you.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The page you asked for does not exist or has moved.

magicLink.subject: Your Pairly sign-in link
magicLink.body: Use the link below to sign in to Pairly.
magicLink.expires: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {org} on Pairly
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to join {org} on Pairly as {role}. Use the link below to accept.
invitation.expires: The link works once, only for this email address, and expires in {days} days.
invitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this email.

Invite.title: Join {org}
Invite.body: You are invited to join {org} on Pairly as {role}.
Invite.signInHint: We send the link to the invited address. Open it on this device to continue.
Invite.wrongUserTitle: This invitation is for someone else
Invite.wrongUser: You are signed in as {current}, but this invitation is for {email}. Sign out, then open the link again.
Invite.invalid: It may have expired, been used already, or been withdrawn. Ask your admin to send a new one.

errors.invitation_invalid: This invitation cannot be used any more. Ask your admin for a new one.
errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address.
errors.email_not_verified: Sign in with the invited email address first.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

Members.title: Members
Members.subtitle: People in {org} and their roles. New people join by invitation.
Members.inviteBody: They get an email with a link that works once, for 7 days, and only for that address.
Members.notEmailed: The invitation was created but the email could not be sent. Share this link with {email} yourself:
Members.readOnly: You can see members. Ask an admin to invite people or change roles.

errors.invalid_input: Check the email address and role.
errors.invitation_pending: This person already has a pending invitation.
errors.already_member: This person already has this role.
errors.second_factor_required: Sign in with two-factor authentication to invite people.
errors.invitation_closed: This invitation is no longer pending.

SecondFactor.setupBody: Your role lets you approve, decide or manage. Pairly asks for a code from an authenticator app before you can do that.
SecondFactor.reauthTitle: Sign in again with your code
SecondFactor.reauthBody: Two-factor is on, but this session started without a code. Sign in again and enter the code from your authenticator app.
SecondFactor.reauthAction: Sign out and sign in again
SecondFactor.canStill: You can still read everything your role allows.

Settings.subtitle: Your own preferences, and the organisation settings your role can change.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Choose how and when Pairly tells you about things: channels, digests, snooze and quiet hours.

security.title: Security
security.body: Two-step sign-in and backup codes for your account.

members.title: Members
members.body: People in your organisation, their roles and invitations.

policies.title: Policies
policies.body: Policy documents used to check work, and versioned rule sets.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.body: Turn optional features on or off for your organisation.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.body: Keys for scripts and other systems. They can read, propose and upload, never approve.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.body: Send signed event notifications to your other systems.

BackupCode.title: You signed in with a backup code
BackupCode.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {You have no backup codes left.} one {You have # backup code left.} other {You have # backup codes left.}} Use your authenticator app next time.
BackupCode.unknown: That code is now used up. Use your authenticator app next time.

Unsubscribe.valid: You will no longer get {category} emails from Pairly. Other emails and in-app notifications stay on.
Unsubscribe.done: We will not send you these emails any more. You can turn them back on in settings.
Unsubscribe.expired: Unsubscribe links work for 60 days. Sign in to manage which emails you get.
Unsubscribe.invalid: It may be incomplete or changed. Sign in to manage which emails you get.
Unsubscribe.unavailable: We could not reach Pairly just now. Try again later, or sign in to manage which emails you get.
Unsubscribe.manage: Sign in to manage email settings

SettingsCommon.secretOnce: Copy it now. You will not see it again.

StepUp.title: Confirm it is you with your authenticator code
StepUp.reauthBody: This action needs a sign-in with your authenticator code. Sign in again and you come straight back here.
StepUp.setupBody: This action needs two-step sign-in. Turn it on under Security, then come back.
StepUp.reauthAction: Sign in again with my code

Errors.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
Errors.permission_denied: Your role does not allow this.
Errors.second_factor_required: This needs a sign-in with your authenticator code.
Errors.not_found: We could not find it. It may have been removed, or you may not have access.
Errors.conflict: Something changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
Errors.gone: This link cannot be used any more.
Errors.invalid_input: Some of the details are not valid. Check them and try again.
Errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
Errors.unavailable: Pairly could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
Errors.approval_state_conflict: This item moved on before your decision arrived. It has been reloaded.
Errors.segregation_of_duties: You prepared or submitted this item, so someone else must decide it.
Errors.not_assigned: This step is not assigned to you.
Errors.idempotency_key_reused: This decision was already sent with different details. Reload and try again.
Errors.test_key_not_allowed: Test keys work only in a sandbox organisation. Choose Live.

fallback.guardrail: {subject} contains content that may try to manipulate an AI system: "{evidence}".
fallback.risk: This check raised something a person should look at.

hidden_text.low_contrast: {subject} contains white or near-background text that a person cannot see: "{evidence}".
hidden_text.background_colour: {subject} contains text set in the page background colour, so a person cannot see it: "{evidence}".
hidden_text.invisible_render_mode: {subject} contains invisible text that only software can read: "{evidence}".
hidden_text.tiny_font: {subject} contains text in a font too small for a person to read: "{evidence}".
hidden_text.off_page: {subject} contains text placed outside the visible page: "{evidence}".
hidden_text.docx_hidden: {subject} contains text marked as hidden in Word, so a person does not see it: "{evidence}".

instruction.ignore_instructions: {subject} contains text that tells an AI system to ignore its instructions: "{evidence}".
instruction.role_override: {subject} contains text that tries to change the role of an AI system: "{evidence}".
instruction.system_prompt: {subject} mentions the hidden instructions of an AI system: "{evidence}".
instruction.ranking_manipulation: {subject} contains text that tells an AI system how to rank or score it: "{evidence}".
instruction.approval_manipulation: {subject} contains text that tells an AI system to approve or mark it as paid: "{evidence}".
instruction.bank_change: {subject} contains text that asks to change bank details: "{evidence}".
instruction.review_bypass: {subject} contains text that asks to skip a check or a review: "{evidence}".
instruction.model_addressing: {subject} contains text written to an AI system rather than to a person: "{evidence}".
instruction.role_marker: {subject} contains chat role markers used to inject instructions: "{evidence}".
instruction.tool_directive: {subject} contains a command or JSON aimed at an AI tool: "{evidence}".
instruction.output_control: {subject} contains text that tells an AI system what to answer: "{evidence}".
instruction.hidden_message: {subject} contains a message hidden in invisible characters: "{evidence}".

keyword_stuffing.repetition: {subject} repeats the same keyword far more often than normal writing does: {evidence}.
keyword_stuffing.skill_list: {subject} contains a long list of keywords with no sentences around them: "{evidence}".

metadata_injection.metadata_instruction: {subject} hides instructions in its file properties: "{evidence}".
metadata_injection.metadata_text: {subject} keeps a long text in its file properties, where a person does not see it: "{evidence}".
metadata_injection.filename_instruction: {subject} has a file name that contains instructions: "{evidence}".
metadata_injection.email_instruction: {subject} arrived in an email whose subject or headers contain instructions: "{evidence}".

unusual_unicode.bidi_override: {subject} uses characters that reverse the reading direction to disguise text: "{evidence}".
unusual_unicode.zero_width: {subject} contains invisible zero-width characters inside words: "{evidence}".
unusual_unicode.tag_characters: {subject} contains invisible tag characters that can carry a hidden message: "{evidence}".
unusual_unicode.variation_selectors: {subject} contains a long run of invisible variation selectors: "{evidence}".
unusual_unicode.homoglyph: {subject} contains words that mix look-alike letters from different alphabets: "{evidence}".

guardrails.findings: The document contains content that may try to manipulate an AI system, so a person must review it.
guardrails.clean: No hidden text or instructions to an AI system were found in the document.

extraction.ok: Every required field was read with enough confidence.
extraction.low_confidence: Some fields were read with low confidence, so a person should check them.

duplicate.none: No other document with the same file was found.
duplicate.same_file: The same file was submitted before, so this may be a duplicate.

amount.insufficient_history: There is not enough history yet to tell whether the amount is usual.
amount.usual: The amount is in line with earlier ones.
amount.outlier: The amount is far from earlier ones, so it needs a closer look.

risk.detector_error: This check could not run, so a person must review the item.
risk.detector_failed: This check could not run, so a person must review the item.
risk.detector_model_unavailable: The model behind this check was not available, so a person must review the item.

Viewer.title: Document
Viewer.notScanned: The document is still being checked for viruses. Try again in a moment.
Viewer.notFound: We could not find this document, or you cannot see it.
Viewer.error: The document could not be shown. Try again.
Viewer.legendEvidence: Evidence: where a value was read
Viewer.legendGuardrail: Guardrail finding: content that may try to manipulate an AI system

Inbox.title: Inbox
Inbox.pickOne: Pick an item from the list to see it here.
Inbox.emptyBody: New approvals show up here as soon as they need you.
Inbox.noMatchBody: Try another word or clear the search.
Inbox.loadMoreFailed: More items could not be loaded. Try again.
Inbox.hint: Press <kbd>J</kbd> and <kbd>K</kbd> to move, <kbd>?</kbd> for all shortcuts.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: Shortcuts work when you are not typing in a field.

Inbox.cannotDecide: You cannot decide this one. It may not be assigned to you, or you prepared it.
Inbox.notFound: This item is not available to you any more.
Inbox.loadError: The details could not be loaded. Pick the item again to retry.
Inbox.openDocument: Open the document on its own page

approve.title: Approve this?
approve.body: You are approving "{title}". This is final and the next step starts at once.

reject.title: Reject this?
reject.body: You are rejecting "{title}". This is final. The person who submitted it sees your reason.

request_changes.title: Ask for changes
request_changes.body: "{title}" goes back to the person who submitted it, with your reason.

dialog.reasonHint: Required. Say what is wrong or what to change. Press Ctrl and Enter to send.

ApprovalLink.signInBody: This approval link is for one person. Sign in with your work email, then your authenticator code, to see what it does. Nothing happens until you confirm.
ApprovalLink.unavailableTitle: We cannot check this link right now
ApprovalLink.unavailable: Pairly could not be reached. Try again in a moment.

approve.title: Approve this item
approve.body: Check the details, then confirm. Nothing happens until you do.

reject.title: Reject this item
reject.body: Check the details, give a reason, then confirm. Nothing happens until you do.

request_changes.title: Ask for changes
request_changes.body: Check the details, say what to change, then confirm. Nothing happens until you do.

ApprovalLink.finalNote: This decision is final and recorded with your name.
ApprovalLink.doneBody: The link is used up now. You can see the item and its history in your inbox.
ApprovalLink.invalid: It may have expired, been used already, or been sent to someone else. You can still decide from your inbox.
ApprovalLink.invalidSignedIn: You are signed in as {email}. If the link was sent to another address, sign out and sign in as that person.

Decision.title: Decision record
Decision.personalHidden: Personal data hidden for your role
Decision.noHumanAction: No person has acted on it yet
Decision.noEvidence: No evidence was recorded for this decision.
Decision.auditEvents: {count, plural, one {See # audit event} other {See # audit events}}

replay.title: Replay
replay.body: Run the decision again with the same inputs, policy, prompt and model settings, and see whether the result matches.
replay.none: This decision has not been replayed yet.
replay.diffCaption: Differences between the recorded and the replayed result
replay.fingerprinted: Personal values are shown as fingerprints, not as text.

appeals.title: Appeals
appeals.fileBody: Record a request for human review on someone's behalf. It goes to the appeals queue with a deadline.

Audit.subtitle: Every action in your organisation, in order, in a chain that shows any change.
Audit.invalidFilter: Those filters are not valid. Check the dates and values.
Audit.quickPlaceholder: Search this page by action, entity or id
Audit.emptyBody: Change the filters or clear them.
Audit.showing: {count, plural, one {# event on this page} other {# events on this page}}

filters.label: Search the audit log
filters.title: Filters
filters.hint: Each value must match exactly. Dates are whole days in UTC.

chain.title: Chain check
chain.body: Each event is linked to the one before it by a hash, and the chain head is signed and stored outside the database every night. A check recomputes every link.
chain.queued: The chain is long, so the check runs in the background. This page updates when it is done.
chain.failed: The check could not finish. Try again.
chain.ok: The chain is intact: {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} checked, up to event {seq}.
chain.broken: The chain is broken at event {seq}. Tell your security team.
chain.brokenNoSeq: The chain does not match its anchors. Tell your security team.
chain.anchorsUnavailable: The anchors could not be loaded.
chain.noAnchors: No anchor yet. The first one is written tonight.

NotificationSettings.channelsBody: Pick the channels for each kind of message, and whether email and Slack arrive at once or in one daily digest.
NotificationSettings.urgentNote: Urgent items, such as missed deadlines and approvals that block others, always arrive at once on the channels you keep on.
NotificationSettings.quietBody: Messages that arrive in quiet hours wait until they end.
NotificationSettings.quietInvalid: Quiet hours need a start and an end that differ.

FlagsSettings.readOnly: You can see the flags. Only admins can change them.
FlagsSettings.overridden: Changed for your organisation. The default is {value}.

ApiKeysSettings.createBody: Give it a clear name and only the scopes it needs. Keys can read, propose and upload. They can never approve.
ApiKeysSettings.name: Name
ApiKeysSettings.scopesHint: Only scopes your own role holds are listed.
ApiKeysSettings.noScopes: Your role holds no scope a key can have.
ApiKeysSettings.meta: {scopes, plural, one {# scope} other {# scopes}} · expires {expires} · last used {used}
ApiKeysSettings.revokeBody: "{name}" stops working at once. Anything that uses it will fail.
ApiKeysSettings.modeHint: Test keys work only in a sandbox organisation.

WebhooksSettings.createBody: Pairly sends a signed POST to this address for each event you pick. Failed deliveries are retried.
WebhooksSettings.readOnly: You can see the endpoints. Only admins can change them.
WebhooksSettings.urlRedacted: Part of the address is hidden for your role.
WebhooksSettings.failures: {count, plural, one {# failed delivery in a row} other {# failed deliveries in a row}}
WebhooksSettings.rotateBody: The old secret stops working at once. Update your receiver with the new one.

PoliciesSettings.emptyBody: Upload your expense, travel or hiring policy so checks can cite it.
PoliciesSettings.uploadBody: A file with the same name becomes its next version. Every file is checked for hidden instructions before it is used.
PoliciesSettings.name: Name
PoliciesSettings.nameHint: Lower case letters, digits, dots and dashes, for example travel-policy.
PoliciesSettings.uploadedBody: It is checked and indexed in the background.
PoliciesSettings.overrideBody: The flagged passages stay left out. Serious findings need a second admin to agree.
PoliciesSettings.overrideReasonHint: At least 10 characters. It is recorded in the audit log.
PoliciesSettings.overrideDone: Override done. The policy is being indexed.
PoliciesSettings.awaitingOther: You asked to use it anyway. Another admin must approve.
PoliciesSettings.awaitingYou: Another admin asked to use it anyway. You can approve the override.
PoliciesSettings.archiveBody: "{title}" stops being used for checks. This cannot be undone.
PoliciesSettings.warnings: {count, plural, one {# guardrail warning} other {# guardrail warnings}}
PoliciesSettings.warningsHidden: Only policy managers can see the warnings.

rules.title: Rule sets
rules.body: Rule sets are versioned. Open one by name to see its versions and try it on sample facts.
rules.name: Rule set name
rules.dryRunBody: Check sample facts against a version. Nothing is stored.
